Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the Mission Street GameStop at 6 a.m. to buy the new Zelda game. About 10 other gamers formed a line behind them over the next three hours, hoping to get physical copies. The friends wanted the collector’s edition, and they got the first three purchase slots.
